authorities.derived_rail: campaign_proto_projection_current_v1 joined to its immutable campaigns.v1 inbox bytes
authorities.authority_rail: latest campaign.events.v2 aggregate and campaign.membership.events.v2 relation projections at or before as_of

scope.as_of: an explicit coordinated projection snapshot at or after window_through; direct legacy callers default it to window_through, while workers bind it to the execution snapshot time

candidate_policy.late_authority_projection_replay: re-run the same immutable CEP event-time window with a later as_of; never move the CEP event into a different window
candidate_policy.membership_state: latest relation revision at as_of must be AlertLinked
candidate_policy.candidate_condition: derived alert ID set intersects authority linked alert ID set

receipt.correlation_key: sha256 length-delimited tenant_id, cep_campaign_id and cep_event_id; excludes processing time
receipt.correlation_sha256: canonical correlation meaning and source watermarks; excludes as_of, correlation_id and correlation_version so a processing-time-only replay returns the existing row

reconcile.oracle: exact set of the latest non-revoked (tenant_id,cep_event_id,correlation_sha256) at or before as_of for the closed window
